[ICCV 2025] GraspCoT: Integrating Physical Property Reasoning for 6-DoF Grasping under Flexible Language Instructions

GraspCoT: Integrating Physical Property Reasoning for 6-DoF Grasping under Flexible Language Instructions (ICCV 2025) Xiaomeng Chu, Jiajun Deng, Guoliang You, Wei Liu, Xingchen Li, Jianmin Ji, Yanyong Zhang ## Overview This repository is an official implementation of [GraspCOT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.16013), an innovative 6-DoF grasp detection framework that integrates a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning mechanism oriented to physical properties, guided by auxiliary question-answering (QA) tasks. The video demonstration is included [here](assets/2338_video_demo.mp4). ## Environment We test our codes under the following environment: * Python 3.10 * Pytorch 2.1.0 * CUDA Version 11.8 1. Clone this repository. 2. Install packages. 3. Install other dependencies: ## Prepare Dataset 1. Make data folder. 2. Download nuScenes from [Grasp-Anything-6D](https://huggingface.co/datasets/airvlab/Grasp-Anything-6D), follow their usage instructions, and put it in `data/grasp_anything`. 3. Download the revised scenario description file with bugs fixed from [Google Drive](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1hpDD6PSA9l4vqDmtyUfM9rqzHpK9aQs-/view?usp=sharing), unzip, and replace the original directory `scene_description` (downloaded from the previous step) in `data/grasp_anything`. 4. Download the generated flexible instruction info files of [train](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1VLga3xvwh5qyUNNyb73odzxDvSttCMiA/view?usp=sharing) and [val](https://drive.google.com/file/d/17Ri0tnFqir023IIvWpT-AeC1RuqvBR68/view?usp=sharing) sets, and put them in `data/grasp_anything/dialogues`. 5. Generate the projected images, depth maps, and a series of grasping info files from the colored point cloud. 6. Folder structure: ## Training 1. Make a folder for pretrained LLM models. 2. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：GraspCoT 以 LLaVA-3D-7B 为基座，在 6-DoF 抓取检测中引入面向物理属性的思维链（Chain-of-Thought）推理机制，并用一组辅助问答（QA）任务进行引导与监督，从而把灵活语言指令解析为物理属性推理再映射为抓取位姿。


# 一、动机

> 现有 6-DoF 抓取检测在灵活语言指令下往往只做语义对齐，缺乏对物体物理属性（如材质、重心、可抓性）的显式推理，导致面对隐含物理约束的指令时抓取位姿不可靠。


# 二、方法

> GraspCoT 以 LLaVA-3D-7B 为基座，在 6-DoF 抓取检测中引入面向物理属性的思维链（Chain-of-Thought）推理机制，并用一组辅助问答（QA）任务进行引导与监督，从而把灵活语言指令解析为物理属性推理再映射为抓取位姿。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 仓库与摘要层面可确认的信息：工作被 ICCV 2025 接收；基于 Grasp-Anything-6D 数据集（含修改后的场景描述与 train/val 灵活指令标注）训练，基座为 7B 的 LLaVA-3D-7B 与 CLIP ViT-L/14-336；实验环境为 Python 3.10 + PyTorch 2.1.0 + CUDA 11.8。提供的摘要/README 中未给出具体成功率、AP 等量化指标，需查阅 arXiv:2503.16013 正文确认。


# 四、对我的启发

> 与机器人抓取课题高度相关：其“物理属性 CoT + 辅助 QA 监督”的思路可迁移到具身操作中的语言条件策略学习。局限在于依赖大视觉语言模型与高质量 CoT/QA 标注，推理开销可能影响实时抓取闭环，且物理属性推理是否真正优于端到端语义对齐仍有待正文消融验证。
